data.long_meaning: The name Juhaynah is derived from the Arabic language. It is a beautiful and meaningful name in Islamic culture, signifying a woman who is pure, radiant, and full of grace. This name is mentioned in the Hadith, where Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) described Juhaynah as being 'pure and radiant'. The name Juhaynah carries the meaning “Pure and radiant woman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juhaynah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and radiant woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juhaynah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
